description: Unit tests for POSIX time functions, including gettimeofday, CurrentPosixTime, CurrentMonotonicTime, and gmtime_r, verifying time accuracy, resolution, monotonicity, and correctness of time conversion functions.

methods.name: TimeMatchesGettimeofday
methods.description: Verifies that time() and gettimeofday() return consistent values within one second.

methods.name: TimeIsKindOfSane
methods.description: Checks that CurrentPosixTime() returns a value between the past (2024) and future (2044).

methods.name: HasDecentResolution
methods.description: Ensures CurrentPosixTime() updates within a second over multiple iterations.

methods.name: MonotonicIsMonotonic
methods.description: Verifies that CurrentMonotonicTime() is strictly increasing and within expected bounds.

methods.name: GmtimeR
methods.description: Tests gmtime_r() converts a fixed timestamp to correct UTC components.
